name: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Ltd.
business_summary: Government-owned (71.76%, MNRE) public financial institution and non-deposit NBFC lending to renewable energy projects (solar, wind, hydro, biomass, storage, green hydrogen) and energy efficiency. Loan book ~Rs90k cr (derived), revenue Rs8,339cr in FY26 (+23%), TTM profit Rs1,968cr; Q2 FY27 PAT Rs552cr (screener; Rs554cr ET) vs Rs549cr a year earlier, flat YoY with operating profit +17% and bad loans easing. Funded by bonds, bank loans and multilateral lines. Trades at ~2.1x book, P/E 15.6, ROE 15.6%, -27.6% over 12 months, beta ~1.9.

exposures.mechanism: +1 = stronger support (ISTS waiver extensions, VGF/PLI, solar rooftop, storage mandates): sanctions/disbursement growth +8-10pp -> loan book +8% over 12m -> NII +8% (spread stable) -> PAT +8% x persistence 1.0 x EV/MCap ~1 => +8. IREDA is a pure-play on renewable capex financing.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 net profit Rs554cr (ET EnergyWorld); operating profit +17%, bad loans ease (CNBC TV18 2026-10-19)

exposures.mechanism: +1: faster RE addition target (500 GW by 2030, model knowledge) -> annual RE financing need +10% -> IREDA's loan growth 25% -> 28% => NII +3% pa; capitalised on 2.1x P/B growth => +6.

evidence.note: screener: mcap Rs30,705cr, price 109, P/E 15.6, P/B ~2.1, ROE 15.6%, Sep-26 qtr PAT Rs552cr, TTM Rs1,968cr; price 12m -27.6%, beta ~1.9

exposures.mechanism: +3pp electricity demand growth -> more capacity auctions and PPAs signed (unsigned PPA backlog is a known bottleneck, model knowledge) -> disbursal +3% => PAT +3% x 0.8 => +2.5.

evidence.note: screener: mcap Rs30,705cr, price 109, P/E 15.6, P/B ~2.1, ROE 15.6%, Sep-26 qtr PAT Rs552cr, TTM Rs1,968cr; price 12m -27.6%, beta ~1.9

exposures.mechanism: +25bp: IREDA raises ~Rs35-45k cr pa via bonds (market-linked); AAA PSU yield tracks G-sec so the marginal 40% of borrowings reprice within 12m: +25bp x 40% x Rs75k cr = Rs75cr = 3.0% of PBT (Rs2.5k cr) x persistence 0.5 = -1.5; discount rate on a 2.1x P/B stock at beta 1.9 adds -1.5 => -3.0.

evidence.note: screener: mcap Rs30,705cr, price 109, P/E 15.6, P/B ~2.1, ROE 15.6%, Sep-26 qtr PAT Rs552cr, TTM Rs1,968cr; price 12m -27.6%, beta ~1.9

exposures.mechanism: +25bp: loans largely fixed/reset 3-5y (liability-sensitive balance sheet, model knowledge) while bank borrowings (~25% of funding) are MCLR/repo-linked: CoF +10bp on 40% reprice => NIM -4bp = -1.3% NII / -3% PAT x persistence 0.5 => -1.5; credit-demand/valuation -1.0 => -2.5. RBI hiked 25bp on 2026-10-07.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (Hindu/Reuters/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +50bp AAA PSU spreads: same 40% repricing x Rs75k cr x 50bp = Rs150cr = 6% of PBT x 0.5 => -3.0. Spread stability depends on RBI liquidity and PSU issuance supply.

evidence.note: screener: mcap Rs30,705cr, price 109, P/E 15.6, P/B ~2.1, ROE 15.6%, Sep-26 qtr PAT Rs552cr, TTM Rs1,968cr; price 12m -27.6%, beta ~1.9

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost: loans ~Rs90k cr (derived from revenue/yield) x 0.5% = Rs450cr vs PBT ~Rs2.5k cr => PAT -18%; persistence 0.5 => -9, trimmed -8 as GNPA is easing (CNBC TV18 2026-10-19). Counterparty concentration in developers with PPA/transmission delays and the Stage-3 base is the risk.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 net profit Rs554cr (ET EnergyWorld); operating profit +17%, bad loans ease (CNBC TV18 2026-10-19)

exposures.mechanism: +1 tightening: RBI project-finance directions (provisioning on under-construction projects, effective Oct 2025, model knowledge) and NBFC risk-weights/ECL transition raise provisioning on IREDA's pre-commissioning book (share under construction unverified, assumed ~50%): an extra 0.5% on that half = ~Rs225cr, staged over years, ~9% of one year's PBT x 0.35 => -3.

evidence.note: RBI project finance directions 2025; not re-verified
